title: Early Experience: Data Construction + Dual-Branch Training (IWM & SR)

nodes.label: Expert Dataset D_expert
nodes.semantic_desc: Expert demonstrations consisting of state-action pairs (s_i, a_i); provides expert states for sampling alternatives and expert actions for supervision.
nodes.visual_desc: A dataset cylinder labeled 'D_expert' with small tuple examples like (s_i, a_i) shown as tiny rows.

nodes.label: Environment
nodes.semantic_desc: Interactive environment simulator; takes a state and an action execution and outputs the resulting next state (future state) observation.
nodes.visual_desc: A rounded rectangle labeled 'Environment' with a subtle grid/world icon in the corner.

nodes.label: Initial LLM Policy
nodes.semantic_desc: Starting LLM-based policy used to generate K non-expert candidate actions conditioned on expert state s_i; outputs a set of sampled actions {a_i^j}.
nodes.visual_desc: A rounded rectangle module labeled 'LLM Policy (init)' with a small transformer-stack icon.

nodes.label: Candidate Actions (K)
nodes.semantic_desc: Sampled alternative actions {a_i^1..a_i^K} for each expert state s_i; serves as action inputs for environment rollouts and downstream training data construction.
nodes.visual_desc: A fan-out list/stack of small action tokens labeled a^1, a^2, ..., a^K.

nodes.label: Expert Action Rollout
nodes.semantic_desc: Executes expert action a_i from expert state s_i in the environment; outputs expert-induced next state s_{i+1} used for self-reflection comparison.
nodes.visual_desc: A rounded rectangle labeled 'Execute a_i' with a single arrow glyph inside (purely decorative).

nodes.label: Alt Action Rollouts
nodes.semantic_desc: Executes each sampled alternative action a_i^j from s_i in the environment; outputs resulting future states s_i^j for each candidate action.
nodes.visual_desc: A rounded rectangle labeled 'Execute a_i^j (j=1..K)' with a small multi-branch icon.

nodes.label: Rollout Dataset D_rollout
nodes.semantic_desc: Constructed rollout triples (s_i, a_i^j, s_i^j) using environment executions; provides future-state supervision without explicit rewards.
nodes.visual_desc: A dataset cylinder labeled 'D_rollout' showing tiny triple rows (s_i, a_i^j, s_i^j).

nodes.label: Implicit World Modeling
nodes.semantic_desc: IWM training branch; takes (s_i, a_i^j) from D_rollout and trains the LLM policy to predict the corresponding future state s_i^j as a next-token prediction task.
nodes.visual_desc: A rounded rectangle labeled 'IWM' with a small 'state→state' schematic icon.

nodes.label: Future State Prediction
nodes.semantic_desc: Predicted future state token sequence representing s_i^j; output of IWM branch used to match ground-truth future state in D_rollout.
nodes.visual_desc: A short sequence of tokens/blocks labeled 'ŝ_i^j' rendered as a mini text strip (no readable text required).

nodes.label: NLL Loss (IWM)
nodes.semantic_desc: Negative log-likelihood objective for future-state token prediction; takes predicted future-state tokens and ground-truth s_i^j tokens and outputs a scalar training loss.
nodes.visual_desc: A small hexagon labeled 'NLL' (or a small loss box) with a sigma/penalty icon.

nodes.label: Self-Reflection Generator
nodes.semantic_desc: SR branch module prompting the LLM to compare expert outcome s_{i+1} (from a_i) against alternative outcomes s_i^j (from a_i^j) and produce a natural-language critique/explanation c_i^j.
nodes.visual_desc: A rounded rectangle labeled 'Self-Reflection (SR)' with a small speech-bubble icon.

nodes.label: Reflection Text c_i^j
nodes.semantic_desc: Natural-language explanation stating why expert action is better than alternative; produced per (s_i, a_i^j) comparison and used as supervision for reflection training.
nodes.visual_desc: A speech bubble containing blurred/placeholder lines representing text (unreadable).

nodes.label: Reflection Dataset D_refl
nodes.semantic_desc: Constructed reflection supervision tuples (s_i, a_i^j, c_i^j); used alongside expert demonstrations to train the policy to generate both reflection text and correct expert actions.
nodes.visual_desc: A dataset cylinder labeled 'D_refl' with tiny tuple rows (s_i, a_i^j, c_i^j).

nodes.label: Joint Training Objective
nodes.semantic_desc: Multi-task training stage combining expert action prediction (from D_expert) and reflection generation (from D_refl); updates the LLM policy parameters using both supervision signals.
nodes.visual_desc: A rounded rectangle labeled 'Joint Training' with two small task icons (action token + text bubble).

nodes.label: Updated LLM Policy
nodes.semantic_desc: Resulting policy after IWM and SR-based training; outputs improved action selection and can generate self-reflection explanations.
nodes.visual_desc: A rounded rectangle labeled 'LLM Policy (trained)' with a small upward arrow or 'updated' badge.
